end.summary:
Recognised in several examples that turning or moving a shape does not change its size or shape.
Copied shapes on grids by counting units along sides in most attempts.
Completed a tile pattern and identified the next colour.
Initially counted dots instead of gaps, then corrected this by counting the spaces between dots.
At the end, again said that turning changes length and width; this was not corrected later.
end.parentNote: Myra practised recognising and copying shapes on square and dot grids, and continuing tile patterns. Counting the gaps between dots was corrected during the lesson using the stepping-stones method. The idea that a turn changes a shape’s length and width came up again at the end, so at home, please turn a paper shape together and check that its sides and size stay the same.
